notes: Stated as an obby, and the shape answer picks a compact tower stacking upward, so course-tower and the Tower Obby preset fit without a substitution. P6 is the genre-wide route and is never dropped — physics-legal spacing is the game — and the P2 comes from the tower itself, since sections wrapping directly above each other genuinely overhang, so it is not an override candidate. I read 'different colour stages' as discrete stages rather than one continuous Tower-of-Hell climb, so I added checkpoint-respawn on top of the preset, colour-coding each stage band. The end of the run is the top of the tower, which is what winner-zone places; the toy-like plastic look is styling on the same geometry.
